description: O(NC_size × A) allocations — lines 1245-1246 clone permitted_subtrees and excluded_subtrees from anchor.name_constraints at the top of every chain_walk call. During key rollover with N matching anchors, each attempt clones the full NC collections. Expected impact: reduced heap pressure in multi-anchor or large-NC scenarios; the anchor NC data is immutable and could be borrowed as a starting reference rather than cloned.
title: chain_walk: clones anchor NC subtrees on every anchor attempt
